steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Rate of Change: The gradient of a straight line graph represents the rate of change of y with respect to x. It tells us how much y changes for each unit change in x.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Find the gradient of the line through (3, 8) and (7, 24). | A distance-time graph shows points (0, 0) and (3, 180). Distance in miles, time in hours. Find the speed. | A velocity-time graph has gradient -4. What does this mean?

steps.title: Lesson 4: Exam Practice
steps.body: Extended Answer 6 marks: A car accelerates uniformly from rest, reaching a speed of v m/s in 8 seconds. It then travels at this constant speed for 12 seconds before decelerating uniformly to rest in 4 seconds. The total distance travelled is 560 m. (a) Sketch the speed-time graph.
